title: When Harvests Fail
description: Three failures I can name: the Hollis grain in Elder Moor that never broke soil, Edda's field, and the Thornfield mill half empty before frost. I think dark magic is under all three. Find it before a fourth household joins them.

objectives.description: See why the Hollis family's grain never sprouted
Check whether Edda's field is failing the same way
Count what is left in the Thornfield mill's stores
Find the cursed totem near Crossroads
Destroy the cultist circle maintaining the curse
Defeat the Dark Ritualist leading the curse
Bring the cursed totem to Priestess Elara

notes: The audit's named failure for this quest: three towns investigated, no farmer named. Fixed - the Hollis family (invented, Elder Moor) joins Edda (already established in gaela_01-03) and the Thornfield mill's own stores as the three concrete stakes. Giver motive: Elara names them because a regional famine that stays abstract does not move anyone to hurry. Consequence: not wired; a fourth household joining the list is stated as the cost of failure, not enforced in data.
